question: Does the local session batch cap of 1 materially cause the observed permission-cohort admission refusals under the original arrival distribution?

single_changed_effective_field.meaning: maximum batch records, not proof of actual 128-record batches; TOML and environment precedence must agree

keep_fixed: Darwin host and fresh data directories
seed1, 10000 online, 2000 groups and exact original workload bytes
all queue/cohort/permission/RPC limits, timeouts, retry policy and verdict thresholds
same finite observation schedule in compared arms; no profile cost in only one arm
manipulation_check: pin exact input diff and resolve effective config after environment override
confirm source/binaries unchanged and no other worker/service run active
observe actual gateway batching when existing metrics expose it; otherwise state actual batch shape unknown
compare permission cohort_requests/cohorts/facts per admitted logical send, without treating missing counters as zero
primary_measures: first_attempt_failures and raw rejected SENDACK class/source
permission cohort_busy by node, active/owned calls/bytes with original caps
new logical SEND and successful logical ACK rates using actual measured duration plus bounded interval cuts
recipient queue/inflight and permission fresh-barrier/RPC duration counts/sums

predictions_and_decisions.observation: B has the same effective/actual batch shape as A despite cap128, or another config/binary changed
predictions_and_decisions.interpretation: Manipulation failed or comparison confounded. No conclusion on the batch hypothesis; preserve failure and do not silently change another variable.

predictions_and_decisions.observation: B materially changes batching/cohort formation, sustains comparable arrival exposure, and lowers cohort_busy/first failures while 3-type delivery expiry remains
predictions_and_decisions.interpretation: Supports batch shape as a contributor to the 32 admission refusals. Delivery-expiry cause remains unresolved and independent.

predictions_and_decisions.observation: B changes batching/cohort formation and eliminates cohort_busy/first failure, with no sampled expiry for a longer bounded exposure
predictions_and_decisions.interpretation: Supports a local batch contribution to congestion. One improved run does not prove cloud causality or a full correctness/72h performance pass; reverse/matched repeat is needed before claiming causal repeatability.

predictions_and_decisions.observation: B changes batching/cohort formation but comparable admission busy and failures persist
predictions_and_decisions.interpretation: Weakens batch-cap-alone explanation. Inspect which original cohort credit is exhausted and fresh-barrier/RPC completion; do not raise caps or timeouts as a diagnostic substitute.

predictions_and_decisions.observation: B lowers offered/actual logical arrival rate, fails bootstrap, is stopped before comparable exposure, lacks complete observations, or loses source/process continuity
predictions_and_decisions.interpretation: Inconclusive. Reduced counters do not establish improvement; retain explicit failed/incomplete result.

predictions_and_decisions.observation: B removes first failures but retains recipient320/320, queue1024/1024, RPC timeouts or hot-latency degradation
predictions_and_decisions.interpretation: Separates front-end permission admission from downstream delivery pressure. Continue narrow diagnosis without treating the 32 and expired sets as the same event.

separate_followups_only_if_justified: service GOMAXPROCS single-variable contrast after batch result, keeping worker cap and compaction fixed
Slot compaction contrast in a different experiment; do not combine it with batch/GOMAX
bounded existing latency/profile observation with matched schedule when a remaining bottleneck requires it
cannot_prove: causal identity join among rejected32, delivery_timeout256 and expired3
signed native channel readiness or complete v3 GA publication
